statement: Finding metadata pages does not prove corpus coverage or freshness; ELI added explicit inventory and update-feed mechanisms to address both.
actakit_implication: Source adapters need separate coverage/freshness/checkpoint semantics; absence in one run is not deletion proof.

statement: Periodic full inventory processing and incremental update feeds serve different ingestion guarantees.
actakit_implication: Allow adapters to report exhaustive inventory versus incremental discovery instead of pretending all source runs have the same completeness.
